messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 9):
"""
16) Final authorization for Discharge from the hospital: a. Insurer shall grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of discharge authorization request from the hospital. In no case, the policyholder shall be made to wait to be discharged from the Hospital. b. If there is any delay beyond three hours, the additional amount if any charged by the hospital shall be borne by the insurer from shareholder’s fund. c.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"How long does an insurer have to grant final authorization for a patient’s discharge after receiving the hospital’s request?","answer":"The insurer must grant final authorization within three hours of receiving the discharge authorization request.","facts":["within three hours","final authorization"]},{"question":"If a hospital charges additional amounts due to a delay beyond the insurer’s three‑hour window, who pays those extra charges?","answer":"The insurer must bear any additional amount charged by the hospital from its shareholder’s fund.","facts":["delay beyond three hours","additional amount if any charged by the hospital","borne by the insurer from shareholder’s fund"]}]}
